findings.description: Unsafe pickle.loads() on untrusted data leading to arbitrary code execution
findings.code_snippet: return {} if self._meta is None else cast(Dict[str, Any], loads(self._meta))
findings.reasoning: The `meta` property in the Style class uses `pickle.loads()` to deserialize `self._meta` bytes. The `self._meta` is set via `pickle.dumps(meta)` in the constructor (line 196) and `from_meta` method (line 247). An attacker who controls the `meta` parameter (a dictionary) can include malicious objects that when pickled and later unpickled via `loads()` execute arbitrary code through the pickle __reduce__ mechanism. This is a classic insecure deserialization vulnerability (CWE-502). The vulnerability is critical because it allows remote code execution if untrusted data reaches the `meta` parameter.
